decisions.reason: The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already captures that images must be added before publication; the internal-link selection basis does not alter the image requirement.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records publication after images and internal links are added; no additional publication-state change is required.
Using relevant keywords to select internal links does not change the approved set of blog keywords.
The source decision concerns internal links and publication readiness, not the workflow for proposing or selecting blog topics.
The reference to relevant keywords for internal linking does not modify the campaign keyword count, selection, or page mapping.
The internal-link publication condition does not affect the requirement to provide keyword search-volume metrics.
The source does not change the requested replacement text or other webpage content.
Internal links within blog articles are distinct from the off-page backlink quantity and follow-type requirements.
